question.problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -12 & -6 & 16 \\ \frac{1}{2} & -2 & 5 & 12 \\ 2 & -20 & -4 & 25\end{aligned}].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce $M$ to row echelon form, and then find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.
question.worked_solution:
Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -12 & -6 & 16 \\ \frac{1}{2} & -2 & 5 & 12 \\ 2 & -20 & -4 & 25\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -12 & -6 & 16 \\ 0 & 4 & 8 & 4 \\ 2 & -20 & -4 & 25\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -12 & -6 & 16 \\ 0 & 4 & 8 & 4 \\ 0 & 4 & 8 & -7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{4}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -12 & -6 & 16 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 8 & -7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-4{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -12 & -6 & 16 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -11\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The corresponding system is now

$$
{\begin{aligned}x-12y-6z=16 \\ 0x+y+2z=1 \\ 0x+0y+0z=-11\end{aligned}
$$

Since there are no such numbers $x,y,z$ that form a solution of the final equation $0x+0y+0z=-11,$ we can conclude that our system has no solution.
